title: Neighborhood clubs and playing what you want
summary: Allen mentions Danny Barker's neighborhood place; Williams agrees playing what you want makes a difference and plans a New York trip.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I saw Danny Baughlin, do you know him?

He's a guitar player. No. He's a guitar player. He's a guitar player. No. He plays Paul Barberin's nephew. I heard of him but I don't know him. Well I had fun going to hear him because it was a neighborhood place. They could relax and play what they wanted to. Oh yeah. And that makes a difference.

Oh yeah, it's a big difference when you can play this if you want to play. Some of them have requested to play this and requested to play that. But if you can play what you want, it's alright. I think I'm going to New York this year. My son's supposed to come here from Mariball. If he don't come, I'm going up there. I'm going to New York with that place.
